_note: Unit identity accents for the curriculum top1 layer. accent is an accessible hue used for borders/badges (not text-on-pale). Keyed by unit number.

1.title: Number Lab
1.mission: Master factors, multiples, and decimal operations so you can compute fluently and explain why your steps work.
1.finalChallenge: Plan a real budget or recipe using exact decimal computation and justify each step.

2.title: Fraction Foundry
2.mission: Divide fractions and reason about parts of a whole using models and equations.
2.finalChallenge: Scale a recipe up or down with fractions and prove your amounts are correct.

3.title: Ratio City
3.mission: Use ratio language, tables, and equivalent ratios to compare quantities and solve real problems.
3.finalChallenge: Design and justify a best-value mixture, recipe, or menu using ratios.

4.title: Rate & Percent Studio
4.mission: Work with unit rates and percents to compare deals, speeds, and parts of a whole.
4.finalChallenge: Compare two real shopping or travel deals and defend the better value with rates and percents.

5.title: Area Architects
5.mission: Find the area of triangles, quadrilaterals, and composite shapes by composing and decomposing figures.
5.finalChallenge: Design a floor plan or garden and calculate its exact area, showing how you decomposed it.

6.title: Expression Engine
6.mission: Write, read, and evaluate expressions with exponents and variables, and prove equivalence.
6.finalChallenge: Model a real situation with an algebraic expression and show two equivalent forms.

7.title: Equation Quest
7.mission: Solve one-step equations and inequalities and represent relationships between variables.
7.finalChallenge: Model and solve a real problem with an equation or inequality and interpret the solution.

8.title: Data Detectives
8.mission: Collect, display, and summarize data with center, spread, and shape to answer statistical questions.
8.finalChallenge: Investigate a real statistical question about your life and present what the data shows.

9.title: Integer Outpost
9.mission: Reason about positive and negative numbers, absolute value, and the coordinate plane.
9.finalChallenge: Map a route or temperature story using integers and the coordinate plane.

10.title: Volume Vault
10.mission: Find volume of right prisms and surface area using nets, connecting 2D and 3D thinking.
10.finalChallenge: Design a package or container and calculate its exact volume and surface area.
